scientific_question: Do structured point-in-time football-information states contain incremental predictive information after conditioning on the same-horizon betting market and the incumbent LevLine forecast?

candidate_families.hypothesis: Expected-lineup shock adds residual information beyond the same-horizon market and incumbent.
candidate_families.feature_definition: For each unit, sum player_value * expected_role_share * probability_available; primary directional feature is current expected unit/team strength minus the previously expected or normal baseline state.
candidate_families.allowed_fit: Only after one harmonized source contract proves chronology, stable identity, missingness, status normalization and feature semantics across the validation universe.
candidate_families.bounded_model_policy: Market-offset regularized logistic residual; no feature subset tournament.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Negative paired Brier delta versus same-horizon market with 95% week-block upper bound below zero, acceptable calibration/log loss, and no one-season concentration.

candidate_families.hypothesis: QB starter probability, starter quality, backup quality, replacement delta and continuity add residual information beyond the same-horizon market.
candidate_families.feature_definition: Separate QB state from ordinary availability; preserve starter probability, backup/replacement state, continuity and uncertainty as distinct fields.
candidate_families.scenario_formula: P(win)=sum_s P(QB_s starts)*P(win|QB_s) only after each conditional component is numerically validated.
candidate_families.bounded_model_policy: No editorial QB point values; no scenario mixture until conditional forecasts pass chronological OOS validation.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Same as H1, plus calibrated starter-probability and replacement-state provenance.

candidate_families.hypothesis: A small predeclared set of personnel-conditioned unit interactions adds residual information after credible lineup state exists.
candidate_families.bounded_model_policy: Hierarchical shrinkage or equivalently conservative regularization; no generic offense-defense interaction soup.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Incremental paired Brier improvement over the simpler H1/H2 model and same-horizon market.

candidate_families.hypothesis: The path by which the same-horizon market probability was reached contains residual information conditional on the current probability.
candidate_families.bounded_model_policy: Use only genuinely captured same-game paths; no imputation from close and no path-rule selection from completed 2026 outcomes.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Incremental paired Brier versus final same-horizon market probability on complete-case path rows.

candidate_families.hypothesis: A historically justified robust or bookmaker-quality-informed consensus can improve the market prior.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Paired Brier improvement versus preregistered robust market consensus with corroborating log loss/calibration.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Official inactive announcements create identifiable information events whose football-state surprise and subsequent market response can be separated.
restrictions: event study precedes any directional correction model
candidate_families.primary_gate: First establish reproducible event alignment; forecasting correction requires a separately frozen residual candidate.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Explicit football structural breaks may require faster state adaptation than generic rolling features.
candidate_families.dependency: Materially distinct from rejected generic dynamic Elo residual.
candidate_families.bounded_model_policy: Predeclare event labels and state-transition form before outcome evaluation; no generic Elo retuning.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Paired Brier gain versus incumbent representation and same-horizon market with season stability.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Beat-reported facts may improve state measurement when converted to governed structured observations, not free-text sentiment or picks.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Extraction accuracy/provenance first; any forecast effect requires a separately preregistered numeric residual model.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Residual corrections should shrink toward zero as input quality or state certainty deteriorates.
candidate_families.restriction: Uncertainty controls magnitude only after a directional residual has independent validation; uncertainty is not itself a directional edge.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Improved proper score/calibration versus identical directional model without uncertainty-aware shrinkage.

candidate_families.hypothesis: Validated player/QB/lineup components can support auditable conditional forecasts distinct from the official forecast of record.
candidate_families.dependency: Requires numerically validated conditional components from H1/H2 or later qualified candidates.
candidate_families.primary_gate: Conditional components must have chronological OOS validation before scenario probabilities are exposed.

stopping_rule: Each candidate receives one execution under this frozen identity. PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or PROSPECTIVE_ONLY. A failed candidate cannot be rescued by changing features, thresholds, interactions, weights, model family or hyperparameters under the same identity.
